translations.translatedText: # Saturday 6.7.2019 (radio)

There was an earthquake in California. A storage hall burned in Mikkeli. Finns are encouraged to pick berries. For Finns it is important that the summer cottage is by the sea or a lake. On Saturday the Day of Poetry and Summer was celebrated. The birds' singing has already begun to decrease.
## Earthquake in California
![Map showing the location of the city of Ridgecrest in the USA.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10865086)
Open image viewer
The centre of the quake was close to Los Angeles. Photo: Tommi Pylkkö / Yle
An earthquake has happened in California, in the USA. The quake was strong, with a magnitude of 7.1.
Nobody was probably killed in the quake. The centre of the earthquake was 200 kilometres from the city of Los Angeles.
There was also an earthquake in the same area 2 days ago. Researchers are afraid that the quakes may continue.
## Fire in Mikkeli
![A firefighter and a fire engine at the rescue station.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10636140)
Open image viewer
Firefighters had a lot of work on Saturday in Mikkeli. Photo: Emilia Malin / Yle
In Mikkeli, in Eastern Finland, there has been a large fire. The fire burned a storage hall.
Nobody was injured in the fire. However, the damage is great, about 500,000 euros.
The storage held many different machines. The fire may have started from a tractor that was in the yard of the storage.
## A berry-picking buddy from Facebook
![A woman picks blueberries.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9754924)
Open image viewer
Picking berries is more fun if you have a friend with you. Photo: Ismo Pekkarinen / AOP
Finns are encouraged to pick berries.
Many people do not pick berries because they do not have a berry-picking buddy. That is why Arktiset Aromit, an organisation in the natural products sector, helps people find a berry-picking buddy.
The organisation started a campaign on Facebook called Marjakaverit (Berry Buddies). With it people can find berry-picking friends and arrange berry trips.
Finland's nature has a lot of berries growing. However, people pick less than 10 percent of the lingonberries and blueberries in the forests, for example.
## Peace at the summer cottage
![Summer cottage in Ohtakari, Kokkola.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10864867)
Open image viewer
Water and peace are important to Finns at the cottage. Photo: Ismo Pekkarinen / AOP
For Finns it is important that the summer cottage is by the sea or a lake. Over 80 percent of respondents in a new survey considered it important that the cottage is by the water.
Their own peace is also important to Finns. Over 70 percent of respondents want to be left in peace at the cottage.
Finns do not long for the company of neighbours at the cottage. About 70 percent of survey respondents think that the company of neighbours is not important.
The survey was carried out by the Municipal Sector Development Foundation.
## Day of Poetry and Summer
![View from Ukko Koli, Pielinen.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10865386)
Open image viewer
For Finns, summer is a time for poetry. Photo: Tiina Tuomaala / AOP
On Saturday the Day of Poetry and Summer was celebrated. The day is celebrated on 6 July, because it is the birthday of Eino Leino.
Eino Leino is Finland's national poet. He died in 1926.
The Day of Poetry and Summer is a flag day.
## Birdsong
![A bird flies to a feeding place to eat.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10130721)
Open image viewer
Birds sing the most at the start of summer. Photo: Noora Haapaniemi / Yle
The birds' singing is already starting to decrease. This is a sign that summer is well advanced.
Birds sing the most at the start of summer.
Now the birds are looking after and feeding their chicks. There are many chicks, because June was warm.
